attempts.text: [{"name": "time_pop", "idea": "Time-local item popularity around the moment of the session: distinct sessions holding the item on the same day of the week as the session's last prefix event, and its smoothed share of all active sessions in the 3 hourly buckets up to that event (prefixes plus the last history day).", "kind": "feature", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH ci AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM cand), sl AS (SELECT s.session, max(s.ts) AS lt FROM sess s JOIN sessions t ON t.session = s.session GROUP BY s.session), sb AS (SELECT session, CAST(floor((lt - {S}) / 86400.0) AS BIGINT) AS d, CAST(floor((lt - {S}) / 3600.0) AS BIGINT) AS hb FROM sl), ae AS (SELECT session, item, ts FROM sess UNION ALL SELECT session, item, ts FROM hist WHERE ts >= {S} - 86400), ie AS (SELECT a.session, a.item, CAST(floor((a.ts - {S}) / 3600.0) AS BIGINT) AS h FROM ae a JOIN ci ON ci.item = a.item), ih AS (SELECT item, h, count(DISTINCT session) AS n FROM ie GROUP BY item, h), idy AS (SELECT item, CAST(floor(h / 24.0) AS BIGINT) AS d, count(DISTINCT session) AS n FROM ie GROUP BY item, CAST(floor(h / 24.0) AS BIGINT)), th AS (SELECT CAST(floor((ts - {S}) / 3600.0) AS BIGINT) AS h, count(DISTINCT session) AS n FROM ae GROUP BY CAST(floor((ts - {S}) / 3600.0) AS BIGINT)), sh AS (SELECT sb.session, sb.hb - v.k AS h FROM sb CROSS JOIN (VALUES (0), (1), (2)) v(k)), hc AS (SELECT c.session, c.item, sum(ih.n) AS n FROM cand c JOIN sh ON sh.session = c.session JOIN ih ON ih.item = c.item AND ih.h = sh.h GROUP BY c.session, c.item), tt AS (SELECT sh.session, sum(th.n) AS n FROM sh JOIN th ON th.h = sh.h GROUP BY sh.session) SELECT c.session, c.item, CAST(coalesce(idy.n, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS ag_i_day_sess, (coalesce(hc.n, 0) + 0.1) * 100000.0 / (coalesce(tt.n, 0) + 100.0) AS ag_i_hr3_share FROM cand c JOIN sb ON sb.session = c.session LEFT JOIN idy ON idy.item = c.item AND idy.d = sb.d LEFT JOIN hc ON hc.session = c.session AND hc.item = c.item LEFT JOIN tt ON tt.session = c.session;"}, {"name": "s_state", "idea": "Session purchase state: number of open carts (items carted after their last order or never ordered), the gap in seconds between the last two prefix events, and the position of the prefix end inside the week.", "kind": "feature", "level": "session", "sql": "WITH s AS (SELECT x.session, x.item, x.ts, x.seq, x.event FROM sess x JOIN sessions t ON t.session = x.session), g AS (SELECT session, item, max(CASE WHEN event = 'cart' THEN seq END) AS lc, max(CASE WHEN event = 'order' THEN seq END) AS lo FROM s GROUP BY session, item), oc AS (SELECT session, sum(CASE WHEN lc IS NOT NULL AND (lo IS NULL OR lo < lc) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n FROM g GROUP BY session), o AS (SELECT session, ts, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY seq DESC, item DESC, event DESC) AS r FROM s), lg AS (SELECT session, max(CASE WHEN r = 1 THEN ts END) - max(CASE WHEN r = 2 THEN ts END) AS gap, max(CASE WHEN r = 1 THEN ts END) AS lt FROM o GROUP BY session) SELECT t.session, CAST(oc.n AS DOUBLE) AS ag_s_open_carts, CAST(lg.gap AS DOUBLE) AS ag_s_last_gap, (lg.lt - {S}) / 86400.0 AS ag_s_week_pos FROM sessions t LEFT JOIN oc ON oc.session = t.session LEFT JOIN lg ON lg.session = t.session;"}, {"name": "i_wk_conv", "idea": "Current-week item conversion from all target-week prefixes: smoothed share of prefixes that carted the item and also ordered it, and smoothed share of the item's prefixes with an order.", "kind": "feature", "level": "item", "sql": "WITH g AS (SELECT session, item, max(CASE WHEN event = 'cart' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c, max(CASE WHEN event = 'order' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS o FROM sess GROUP BY session, item), a AS (SELECT item, count(*) AS n, sum(c) AS nc, sum(o) AS nor, sum(c * o) AS nco FROM g GROUP BY item) SELECT item, (nco + 0.5) / (nc + 2.0) AS ag_i_wk_c2o, (nor + 0.02) / (n + 5.0) AS ag_i_wk_order_rate FROM a;"}, {"name": "wk_last_trans", "idea": "Current-week normalized transitions from the last prefix item to every candidate, prefix items included: share of target-week prefixes holding the last item where the candidate follows within 3 events and within 20 events.", "kind": "feature", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH lp AS (SELECT s.session, s.item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY s.session ORDER BY s.seq DESC, s.item) AS r FROM sess s JOIN sessions t ON t.session = s.session), li AS (SELECT session, item FROM lp WHERE r = 1), ki AS (SELECT DISTINCT item FROM li), a AS (SELECT x.session, x.item, x.seq FROM sess x JOIN ki ON ki.item = x.item), dn AS (SELECT item, count(DISTINCT session) AS tot FROM a GROUP BY item), pr AS (SELECT a.item AS src, y.item AS dst, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN y.seq <= a.seq + 3 THEN y.session END) AS c3, count(DISTINCT y.session) AS c20 FROM a JOIN sess y ON y.session = a.session AND y.item <> a.item AND y.seq BETWEEN a.seq + 1 AND a.seq + 20 GROUP BY a.item, y.item), sc AS (SELECT li.session, pr.dst AS item, pr.c3, pr.c20, dn.tot FROM li JOIN pr ON pr.src = li.item JOIN dn ON dn.item = li.item) SELECT c.session, c.item, sc.c3 * 1.0 / (sc.tot + 1.0) AS ag_wk_last_next3_p, sc.c20 * 1.0 / (sc.tot + 1.0) AS ag_wk_last_next20_p FROM cand c LEFT JOIN sc ON sc.session = c.session AND sc.item = c.item;"}, {"name": "cart_order_aff", "idea": "Order affinity anchored on prefix carts: co-buy count from the most recently carted prefix item (tb_buy2buy) and summed any-to-order sessions from the last 10 carted prefix items (tb_any2order), for every candidate.", "kind": "feature", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH s AS (SELECT x.session, x.item, x.seq, x.event FROM sess x JOIN sessions t ON t.session = x.session), cg AS (SELECT session, item, max(seq) AS cq FROM s WHERE event = 'cart' GROUP BY session, item), cr AS (SELECT session, item, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY cq DESC, item) AS rk FROM cg), lc AS (SELECT session, item FROM cr WHERE rk = 1), bl AS (SELECT lc.session, b.item2 AS item, b.tv_ns AS v FROM lc JOIN tb_buy2buy b ON b.item = lc.item), ao AS (SELECT cr.session, o.item2 AS item, sum(o.tv_ns) AS v FROM cr JOIN tb_any2order o ON o.item = cr.item WHERE cr.rk <= 10 GROUP BY cr.session, o.item2) SELECT c.session, c.item, CAST(bl.v AS DOUBLE) AS ag_lastcart_b2b, CAST(ao.v AS DOUBLE) AS ag_cart_a2o_sum FROM cand c LEFT JOIN bl ON bl.session = c.session AND bl.item = c.item LEFT JOIN ao ON ao.session = c.session AND ao.item = c.item;"}]
